children: Realfiction Holding AB invites shareholders to a virtual investor meeting on Wednesday, 9 September 2026 at 20:00 CEST.

The purpose of the meeting is to provide shareholders with further information regarding the background to the intended Rights Issue announced on 20 August 2026, the Company's current position and financing requirements, as well as its plans and opportunities for the continued commercialization of Directional Pixel Technology (DPT).
During the meeting, management intends to provide further background on:
the Company's current financing situation and the rationale for the intended Rights Issue;
the current status of DPT, including the planned next steps towards industrialization and commercialization;
the ongoing Strategic Review and the Company's approach to strategic and commercial opportunities; and
the background, structure and rationale for the proposed Incentive Programs, including the intended reductions in cash remuneration and salaries and the resulting cash savings for the Company.
The presentation will be followed by a Q&A session, during which shareholders will have the opportunity to ask management questions.
Clas Dyrholm, CEO and Torben Okkels, CFO, will participate in the meeting.
The meeting will be held virtually to enable participation by as many shareholders as possible.

About Realfiction Holding AB

Founded in Denmark in 2008, Realfiction is a provider of cutting-edge 3D display technologies designed for tomorrow’s needs, featuring technological breakthroughs with its Directional Pixel Technology for LCD, OLED and microLED. These technologies support a wide range of use cases, including enhancing driving safety, medical imaging, immersive gaming and entertainment, digital signage, as well as applications in architecture, engineering, and design. The Company offers a comprehensive intellectual property portfolio tailored for OEMs and Tier-1 partners involved in developing and marketing displays for markets and industries requiring high-resolution multistereoscopic displays. All technologies are ready for licensing, and Realfiction is actively pursuing commercial licensing agreements and partnerships to pave the way to mass production. Realfiction's IP portfolio comprises 15 patent families and registered trademarks, including patent applications filed in multiple countries. Realfiction Holding AB’s shares are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm First North under the symbol “REALFI”, with the share’s ISIN code being SE0009920994.
